title: Barguse sinni gira dacrise
intro: qarwali soolah waadol kaxxam meysitah yan arac ambullee wayta, dirki amaanat lem gersi ginook faxe waytaama. gandita roocitte racmatta weeqak, gibdi gacsi girah footimaamih addat qagaaqagita. Atu tama amotani dacrisah mamaxxaga baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu ambullee wayta digaalah bohoy le aracak culmeenal soola.
carara, barguse sinni gira yok dirkik gudet tan.
gandita rooci yi migaq seeca, xaaqimeh cato keenik gaba kalti sinni gadaamat.
oson xaaqimta wak, anu oson mageytiminna maybalaalaqa, umman.
Anu num hinniyo, jinni hinniyo — Anu ginook saytun ammirtima.
Anu jahannab girah amotani dacrise akkuk muggaaqime saqal malayka kinniyo.

arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verse: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." (43:77)
